scope: No sufficient answer in these ten fixed PDFs; not a claim that the information is unknowable or absent elsewhere.
method: Read the paper sections and search the full extracted corpus for the requested experiment, metric or listing. Labels are project-authored and should receive independent human review.

questions.reason: The 2017 GPflow timing experiment reports an older Titan X setup, not RTX 4090/A100 measurements.
The imbalanced-learn article describes sampling methods and API; it does not report this CIFAR-100 comparison.
No fixed 60-second delayed-label experiment or corresponding ranking is reported in this corpus.
The paper does not list the per-run random seeds for the timing experiments.
The MNIST figure illustrates the topological pipeline; the corpus does not provide the requested per-class evaluation matrix.
The River benchmark reports timing and accuracy, not measured energy consumption.
The paper presents clustering plots and code but not a complete row-level ground-truth label listing.
The SB3 article states a single-agent scope and does not report this matched multi-agent eight-GPU experiment.
The reported benchmark table contains mean quantile losses, not a calibrated 90-percent interval-coverage result.
The library article mentions a Nutrimouse loader but does not publish an animal-level train/validation/test assignment.

caution: Term absence alone is not proof of no answer. Positive keyword matches were inspected in context; e.g. tslearn 90% is code coverage, Nutrimouse is a loader mention, and SB3 multi-agent describes RLlib capabilities rather than the requested experiment.
